How activation works

Choose a plan and tell the team which device you use. After activation, you receive the username, password and server details needed by the player. Keep credentials private and enter them exactly as supplied.

Connection recommendations

A stable connection matters more than maximum advertised speed. Around 10 Mbps may suit HD, while 4K generally benefits from 25 Mbps or more. Ethernet or strong Wi-Fi provides the best local result.
